optimizedDescription.value: Orchestrate implementation review combining Core tracking with Code Graph symbol resolution via single provider lifecycle.

optimizedContext.value:
# Build Implementation Review

## Rules

- Signature: `buildImplementationReview(ctx, input)` obtains raw review via `ctx.kernel.changes.getImplementationReview`, opens graph via `withOpenGraphProvider`, gets graph health, resolves symbol links via `ResolveSymbolReference`.
- SDK must not parse source syntax, reimplement symbol matching, or perform presenter formatting. Core owns stored tracking; Code Graph owns resolution.
- Result retains stored spec, file, symbol values unchanged. Symbol links gain structured resolution projection: `status`, `reason`, graph `health` and `coverage`, canonical logical `target`, declarations, `candidates`, `provenance`, and resolution `path`.
- File-level links remain valid without symbol forcing. Never mutate active manifests, links, or archived sidecars.
- Single health evaluation and batch symbol resolution under one opened-provider lifecycle; do not re-open provider per link.
- Graph availability: non-current/incomplete graph yields per-link `unresolved` outcomes; provider initialization/read failures throw standard infrastructure errors, not fake missing links.
- Shared host behavior: CLI `change implementation` and `change status --implementation` consume this identical projection; hosts must not maintain independent fallbacks.

## Constraints

- Returns structured data only.
- Depends on Core and Code Graph through public APIs.
- Resolution diagnostics do not block verification or archive.
